purpose: Run style concepts for owner selection; not animation clips

options.name: Hero Sprint
options.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. A polished RUN ANIMATION DESIGN BOARD for the Roblox game BANDIT EATER. This is a selectable animation idea, not an actual game screenshot or finished animation file.
Style must match a blocky Roblox R15 action game with chunky-cartoon VFX and a low-poly nature arena: compact block torso, rectangular jointed arms and legs, rounded-square head, simple friendly face, short dark brown chunky hair, bright plain blue shirt, dark navy trousers, simple light shoes, warm yellow skin, no accessories or weapons. Identical avatar in every pose, no realistic anatomy, no muscles, no noodle limbs. Matte toy/plastic surfaces, clean 3D concept rendering and warm soft daylight. Nature backdrop uses muted textured grass, sparse faceted rocks and trees, softly out of focus.
Layout: wide landscape design sheet. Large numbered title at top. Upper two thirds: one large attractive three-quarter SIDE hero view of the run's most distinctive airborne stride, moving RIGHT, full body unobstructed, with a small fading white puff behind the last foot contact. Lower third: a clean pale strip with FOUR distinct, evenly spaced full-body right-facing side-view key poses forming one alternating-foot running cycle: left contact, airborne passing, right contact, airborne passing. Captions just '01', '02', '03', '04'. Opposite arm swings opposite forward leg. Feet alternate support. Clearly rotate knees, elbows, hips and chest, retain fixed body proportions. Enough spacing that limbs never overlap another pose. No cropped feet.
FOOTSTEP PUFFS REQUIRED: reuse the look of our existing puff sprite: a soft pearly-white cloud with five or six fat overlapping round lobes and extremely light gray volume shading. A SMALL low cloud pops at the grounded foot on EACH of the two contact poses (left then right); on airborne poses only a smaller fading residual puff stays BEHIND at ground level. Puffs about half a shoe to one shoe wide, do not hide feet or obscure the stride. Soft edges, no gritty smoke, no dark dust, no dense continuous trail, no glow rings, no magical aura, no speed streaks. These puffs are a mandatory shared feature of all five options.
Only title and a short footer 'PUFF ON EACH STEP'. No dense written notes, logos, watermarks, stats, frame timing claims or UI controls. Strong silhouettes and consistent clean presentation.
Specific option: Balanced athletic run, moderate 15-degree forward lean, elbows near 90 degrees, strong alternating arm pumps, long clean alternating strides, small controlled vertical bounce. Confident friendly action hero. This is the practical default.
Exact title: '01  HERO SPRINT'. Make this motion unmistakable in the hero and four key poses.
